backup.production_rule: APPLY AFTER s78_small_sql_20261009 and s78_guards_20261009: migration 3 refuses (55000, nothing changed) unless run_system_verifier_v1 is the s78_guards body (md5 7e92365413fb7bc5a4056a96ac5bf8c5, the live body read 2026-10-08), and migration 2 refuses unless staff_home_v1 is the live f03adb4cc7e6d68be0a717f626c67f63 (= 20261008120000_calendar_day_flags.sql). Four changes. (1) One new function concierge_save_guest_id_v1 (definer, empty search_path, service_role only): files a Messenger ID photo as a guest_companions row (id = the companion id the edge function minted, notes 'Sent in Messenger') on the guest of a confirmed booking_inquiries row, optionally sets guest_profile_details.id_on_file, history rows with changed_by null and reason 'messenger-auto'; reasons come back as data. (2) TASKS #42: staff_guest_companions_v1 (internal, no API role) and staff_home_v1 = the live body plus two counted insertions; owner and admin sessions get companions [{name, has_photo}] on current_guest and next_guest, any other role gets no companions key. (3) TASKS #43: app_settings airbnb_prep_nights = 1 (insert, on conflict do nothing) and run_system_verifier_v1 = the live body with ONE counted replacement of the V1m date test (a mirror block within that many nights of the stay's check-in or check-out is not flagged). (4) Deletes app_settings telegram_bot_token and telegram_marifel_chat_id only where the value still contains PASTE (production read 2026-10-08: both are the PASTE_ placeholders; their only reader log_returning_guest_alert treats NULL like PASTE). Bodies were cut by script (cut.mjs) from the source migrations after asserting the base md5, CR stripped. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs). (5) D-323: intake_resolve_v1 also resolves booking_type airbnb tokens to a confirmed airbnb_reservations row with source airbnb, a guest and checkout not past (Manila); the direct branch is byte-identical to the live body (md5 3bbcebd01aaf5940ce067a6e4372a913).
